chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the junub who has a wound and fears water if it reaches him. He said: “Then he should not wash it if he fears for himself.”

key_terms.الْجُرْحُ: a wound or injury on the body
key_terms.الْجُنُبِ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.نَفْسِهِ: himself, meaning his personal safety or well-being

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a junub person with a wound who fears harm from water?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a junub person who has a wound and fears harm from water. The Imam عليه السلام states that he should not wash the injured area if he fears for his safety, indicating the consideration of harm in rulings of ritual purity.
